name: g2_kaiser_orm_2027
label: R. Kaiser's O/B dwarfs (lambda Ori A, upsilon Ori, 10 Lac, lambda Lep) on every pair of the five ORM telescopes with the INPHYNI 417/431 nm two-polarization camera: one night per pair
notes: R. Kaiser (2026-11-09): 2-3 cameras to install on ORM telescopes in spring/summer 2027; which 2 or 3 telescopes? The run gives every one of the 10 pairs of NOT, TNG, GTC, WHT, INT per night; scripts/kaiser_orm_combos.py ranks the pairs and triples from the per-pair rows.
The four stars are 0.12-0.24 mas: first nulls at 417 nm from 440 m (lambda Ori A) to 840 m (10 Lac), i.e. the 400-1500 m ORM baselines resolve them where CHARA (331 m) only grazes the main lobe.
All five ORM telescopes carry the catalog's ASSUMED optical throughput 0.3.

options.snr_efficiency 0.83: the three-parameter (amplitude, width, centre) fit of the bunching peak that Guerin et al. 2025 (arXiv:2503.22446, Eq. 29, prefactor 0.44) recommend over the matched-filter one-parameter fit (their Eq. 9, prefactor 0.53 = 1/sqrt(2 sqrt(pi))); adopted at W. Guerin's request, e-mail 2026-11-10. The same e-mail set the INPHYNI pair jitter to 35 ps rms.
